A cubic polynomial, \(f(x)\), is generated by randomly selecting the three parameters, \(B\), \(C\), and \(D\), in the equation below.

\[f(x)~=~x^3+Bx^2+Cx+D\]

You know the graph \(y=f(x)\) has three distinct real roots at \(x=-6\), \(x=-2\), and \(x=4\), as shown below.


Find \(B\), \(C\), and \(D\).

  • \(B=\)
  • \(C=\)
  • \(D=\)

First, write the cubic polynomial in factored form (based on the three roots).

\[f(x)~=~(x+{6})(x+{2})(x-{4})\]

Partially expand the expression by writing \((x+{6})(x+{2})\) in standard form. To do this, we can use the FOIL method or a box.

* \(x\) \(6\)
\(x\) \(x^2\) \(6x\)
\(2\) \(2x\) \(12\)

\[f(x)~=~ \left(x^{2}+{2}x+{6}x+{12}\right)(x-{4})\]

Combine like terms.

\[f(x)~=~ \left(x^{2}+{8}x+{12}\right)(x-{4})\]

Now, multiply the quadratic by the linear.

* \(x^2\) \(8x\) \(12\)
\(x\) \(x^3\) \(8x^2\) \(12x\)
\(-4\) \(-4x^2\) \(-32x\) \(-48\)

\[f(x)~=~x^{3}-{4}x^{2}+{8}x^{2}-{32}x+{12}x-{48}\]

Combine like terms.

\[f(x)~=~x^{3}+{4}x^{2}-{20}x-{48}\]

Thus,

  • \(B=4\)
  • \(C=-20\)
  • \(D=-48\)
